images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 3D arcade vehicle game arena concept, landscape 16:9. A winding continuous LOOP surrounds a separate central raised sniper platform with a tiny marksman. Show empty space separating tower from track, and open mostly unguarded track edges. Track three ATV widths on broad sections, narrowing on dangerous sections. Include four cyan checkpoint arches with broad safe restart aprons, banked curves, one short deliberate jump with obvious landing, staggered thick cover walls breaking sight lines from the central tower. A few small orange four-wheel ATVs convey scale and racing. Bone-white large deck slabs, graphite exposed underslung framing, orange hazard stripes and vehicle panels, sparse cyan lights. NOT a ringworld, no recognizable existing franchise designs, no logos, no HUD, no typography, no ground under the track. Prioritize understandable layout and playable spaces over decorative greebles.
